units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 3:1">Targ. Koh. III, 1</cite>, sq. (ed. Vien. <he>עִידָ׳</he>).
Targ. Ps. LXXI, 9 (ed. Wil. עִדָ׳); a. fr.—עד העידנא until now (v. אִידְּנָא).
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 24:55">Targ. O. Gen. XXIV, 55</cite> <he>עידן בעידן</he> (h. text <he>ימים</he>).—
<cite ref="Megillah 16b:5">Meg. 16ᵇ</cite> (prov.) <he>תעלא בעִידְּנֵיה וכ׳</he> when the fox has his time, bow to him.
Ber. 15ᵃ בעִידַּן צלותא when it is time for prayer; a. fr.—Esp. the time appointed for the study of the Law, lesson.

<cite ref="Berakhot 43b:14">Ib. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>דלא קביע ליה ע׳</he> when he has no fixed time for study; <he>אבל קביע ליה ע׳ … דלעידניה קא אזיל</he> but if his time is fixed (by his teacher), he will be known to go to his appointment (and not be suspected of going wrong).
<cite ref="Gittin 60b:14">Gitt. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>לותבן מר בע׳</he> let me sit (to study with you) at the hour of your studies; <he>אית לי ע׳ לדידי</he> that hour is mine (for my own studies).

<cite ref="Chullin 133a:8">Ḥull. 133ᵃ</cite> <he>אנסיה ליה עידניח</he> his teaching engagements prevented him (from officiating as priest); a. fr.—Pl. <he>עִידָּנִין</he>, <he>עִידָּנַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="P00515"><he>עִדָּ׳</he></cite>.
